hero.eyebrow: For people who've studied English but freeze up when speaking
hero.title: Speak English without fear of mistakes.
hero.description: Chat with an AI about whatever you like, at your level. Corrections only come at the end — with examples, turned into flashcards so you don't forget.

converse.title: 1 · Talk
converse.description: Pick a topic and speak freely, by text or voice. The AI chats with you — without correcting anything along the way.

understand.title: 2 · Understand
understand.description: At the end, the AI reviews the whole conversation, highlights what can improve, and explains with examples.

review.title: 3 · Review
review.description: The points become spaced-repetition flashcards. The same mistake in different conversations reinforces the same card.

noJudgment.title: Judgment-free conversation
noJudgment.description: Practice about anything you want, at your level. Corrections never interrupt the conversation.

textOrVoice.title: Text or voice
textOrVoice.description: Speak or type — your choice. Voice transcription keeps your mistakes on purpose, so the analysis is real.

explainedAnalysis.title: Analysis that explains why
explainedAnalysis.description: Every correction comes with an explanation and an example, not just the right sentence.

stickyProgress.title: Progress that sticks
stickyProgress.description: Flashcards with FSRS (the same algorithm Anki uses), XP, and streaks — so practice becomes a habit.

finalCta.title: Ready for your first conversation?
finalCta.description: Sign up with Google or email. No password, no hassle.
